title: 物流事件纯状态机转移矩阵

time_rules.event_high_watermark: An event strictly earlier than the ledger high-watermark is rejected without state or audit mutation.
time_rules.equal_time: An equal-time event is legal only when the current milestone permits that event type.
time_rules.next_update_projection: open_obligation.next_check_at, service_progress_receipt.next_update_by, and proactive_notification_draft.commits_next_update_at use one projected instant.
time_rules.past_promise_guard: When an inherited check is at or before event_time, the reducer projects event_time plus 30 minutes.

rejections_and_replays.direct_delivery: SHIPMENT_DELIVERED from AWAITING_CARRIER_PICKUP returns INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION and leaves state and audit unchanged.
rejections_and_replays.reverse_transition: SHIPMENT_NOT_PICKED_UP from IN_TRANSIT returns INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION and leaves state and audit unchanged.
rejections_and_replays.delivery_before_pickup: SHIPMENT_DELIVERED without an IN_TRANSIT milestone returns INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION.
rejections_and_replays.missing_obligation: Any shipment event without open_obligation returns INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION.
rejections_and_replays.terminal_new_event: A new event after RESOLVED or DELIVERED returns INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION.
rejections_and_replays.exact_replay: A recorded event with the same event_id, event_type, and event_time returns the original outcome with replayed=true and no new audit entry.
rejections_and_replays.conflicting_replay: A recorded event_id with different immutable content returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
rejections_and_replays.rejected_event_audit: Rejected requests do not append audit history.
